summary: The filing is an 8-K reporting a secondary offering of 12,740,384 shares by Ingram Holdco, LLC (selling stockholder), with an exercised 30-day greenshoe of 1,730,769 shares. Ingram Micro Holding Corp concurrently repurchased 1,201,923 shares from underwriters under its existing $175M buyback program, leaving $70M capacity. Underwriters Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs, and J.P. Morgan received no fees on repurchased shares. Proceeds go entirely to the selling stockholder. The filing describes a routine capital markets transaction (follow-on offering with issuer repurchase), not a special situation event; no M&A, activism, or structural change is involved.
